summary: Master advanced data analysis techniques with our comprehensive training course. Gain practical skills to elevate your data-driven decision-making abilities.
lede: Advanced data analysis training is for professionals who work with structured data and need to turn business questions into defensible findings. Learners practise assessing data quality and preparing data, testing statistical conclusions, evaluating predictive and time-series models, and communicating findings and uncertainty in reports and Power BI dashboards.
audienceIntro: This advanced data analysis course is designed for professionals who already work with structured data and need stronger statistical, modelling, and reporting capability.
modules: Advanced Data Analysis Techniques with CRISP-DM
Advanced Data Analysis Techniques with SQL
Statistical Inference with SciPy and statsmodels
Advanced Data Analysis Techniques in Power BI
prerequisites: You should have intermediate experience working with structured datasets, spreadsheets, and basic descriptive statistics. Working knowledge of SQL SELECT queries and Python fundamentals, including variables, functions, and DataFrame operations, is required because the course includes guided coding labs. You should bring a laptop capable of running a modern web browser, JupyterLab, Python packages, and Power BI Desktop where the operating environment supports it. Advanced concepts receive operational application and guided hands-on implementation depth rather than production-grade data engineering coverage.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
